bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs and springboard/sdk/src/restoration.rs (per-app data directory only); springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs (advisory locks); no save sync in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/apps/games-desktop/
summary: GameSave syncs an app's save files through iCloud Drive with conflict resolution, offline play and alerts. BifrOSt has no app-facing save sync: apps get a private local data directory and advisory file locks, and the games app keeps only best scores on disk. The bifrost-cloud backend stores encrypted whole-device backups, but no SDK path maps an app save directory to it.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API returns a cloud-backed directory for an app. The app data directory is local only; nothing syncs it.
